name: Cross-frame Video-ToMe full PolypGen cohort with durable checkpoints
scope: Exploratory complete 21-sequence recovery rerun; original attempt interrupted without complete raw-audit receipts. Same methods, cohorts, evaluation, controls and stopping criteria as frozen v1.
hypothesis: Tokens from different selected past frames with similar SAM2 projected keys and nearby spatial locations may contain complementary useful content. Averaging matched projected values across those frames may improve propagation without selecting whole frames or changing SAM2 weights.

method.upstream_source: tome/merge.py (unmodified author matcher, weighted merge, unmerge)
method.integration: Inside native SAM2 memory-attention SDPA, use mean-head projected K similarity to bipartite-match tokens within local 4x4 spatial tiles across up to six selected past maps. Average matched projected V vectors and unmerge to every original dense slot.
method.matched_control: Use the same official matching operator, local 4x4 tiles and 25% eligible-token merge budget independently within each past frame.
method.native_control: Exact archived native SAM2 outputs with no value transformation.
method.unchanged: SAM2 pretrained parameters, native Q/K and positional encoding, memory writes, six-map schedule, pointers and mask decoder.
method.claim_limit: This is value sharing with dense unmerge; it does not reduce memory-token count or claim a runtime/compute speedup. Object pointers are not used as match centers.

primary_metric: Equal-sequence mean of present-frame Dice; sequence is the resampling unit. Patient independence is unverified.

statistics.unit: sequence; do not treat frames as independent
statistics.multiplicity: Holm correction across the two planned contrasts

decision_rule: If the screen fails, report the result as negative for a reliable meaningful gain and stop this cross-frame value-sharing candidate; do not tune on these 21 sequences.
prior_result_note: A distinct prior 21-sequence within-frame V-pooling study is included in input hashes. It reported native 0.710224, dependency-aware V 0.710984, and a feature-only V control 0.711333; its predefined efficacy screen failed. The present candidate tests cross-frame matching and is not a replication of that intervention.
development_selection_note: seq6 and seq8 were chosen for engineering and mechanism diagnostics after prior outcomes were inspected. Full-cohort results remain exploratory, even though all 21 are evaluated.

object_isolation.scope: two synthetic IDs from a single real polyp mask
